info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Streaming Subscriptions Plans-v5-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Plans API provides access to a comprehensive list of available streaming subscription plans. It enables consumers, such as developers and service providers, to retrieve detailed information about each plan, including features and pricing. This endpoint facilitates the comparison and selection of plans, streamlining the subscription process for end-users. Typical use cases include integrating plan information into applications or websites where users can make informed decisions about their streaming choices.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of subscription plans.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all available subscription plans, including their features and pricing. It's useful for comparing different subscription options.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve subscription plan information. It should contain parameters required to filter or specify the subscription plans to be fetched.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of subscription plans.
